headline_pain: Nothing to Buy in the West?
primary_text: "There's literally nothing available to buy in the size range we need in the west." We know — existing stock is either too big, too old, or already gone. That's exactly why these off-the-plan warehouses in Truganina exist. Multiple size configurations purpose-built for small businesses, not big corporates. Choose the footprint that fits your operation. Located 20km from Melbourne CBD with Princes Freeway and West Gate Tunnel access. New stock is coming and owner-occupiers get first priority. Don't wait for something to hit the market. Secure your size now.
